events.title: Renew ClipPort release token (expires Nov 20)
events.notes:
The GitHub token "clipport release upload" expires on 2027-11-20. After that, ClipPort's release workflow stops at its first step with "RELEASES_REPO_TOKEN cannot reach clipport-releases".

To renew (about two minutes):
1. GitHub > Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens > Fine-grained tokens. Open "clipport release upload" and regenerate it, or make a new one: Only select repositories > clipport-releases, Contents: Read and write, one year.
2. Copy the token. In your own terminal run: gh secret set RELEASES_REPO_TOKEN -R Mario-Recondo/clipport
   Paste it when asked. Do not paste it into a chat.
3. Add a new reminder two weeks before the new expiry date.

Full steps: https://github.com/Mario-Recondo/clipport/issues/163

events.title: Call Miami-Dade Building Dept re: permit 180-day clock
events.notes:
Call 786-315-2000 (customer assistance, Mon-Fri 7:30am-4pm).

Ask:
1. Does a PARTIALLY approved inspection (e.g. "approved partial" on a rough/slab) reset the 180-day permit clock, or only a full approval?
2. Does an approved inspection on a sub-permit (electrical, plumbing, mechanical) extend the MASTER permit's 180 days? And does the master's inspection extend the subs?
3. Do "not ready" or failed inspections count as activity at all?
4. For single-family jobs, is the county still running the 180-day inactivity rule after the 2025 law (HB 1035 / FS 553.79), or does the 1-year floor apply?
